status: Predeclared next audit; no new implementation or Health write performed
dependsOn: Complete and publish accepted Batch42 connection repair first. Keep full product objective active.
observed: OrderedHealthWrites stores only in-memory Task tails and explicitly disclaims durable retry. App termination loses pending operations.
HealthStore commits local meals/water before enqueueing optional Health work. A stop between those steps can leave no durable external intent.
HealthKit meal/water/weight saves suppress errors; meal deletion suppresses per-type errors. Water deletion reports errors only to process-local status.
Water and meals carry Lumen record-ID metadata; weight writes currently have no stable local event identity.
Restore/reset invalidate in-process queued saves. Existing reset says Health data itself remains untouched; restored records must not silently recreate external writes.
LocalStore already has checked linked-file transactions with revision and live-state guards for weight/profile/conversation persistence; inspect this boundary before choosing journal integration.
requiredInvariants: Local record mutation and durable optional Health intent must commit consistently; failure must not publish a success, mutate live state, lose old records or send Health work.
Each event has stable source-owned identity, immutable payload, operation/revision and lifecycle ownership. Retry/restart must not create extra copies or delete another source’s samples.
Acknowledgement is written durably only after verified Health operation outcome. A stop after Health success but before local acknowledgement must be safe to replay.
Save followed by undo/delete stays correctly ordered across process termination. No later saved callback may recreate an entry after completed deletion.
Failures, permissions and unavailable Health remain distinct from confirmed success. Keep retry intent and present an accurate recoverable state.
Cover meal component partial failures and weight events as well as water. Preserve checked local weight/goals/snapshot writes and local-only confirmed conversational corrections.

Restore/reset change the lifecycle safely: old in-flight completions cannot acknowledge or start work for a new lifecycle; restored records do not manufacture fresh Health writes. Preserve explicit pending deletion semantics.
Backups/readable exports/legacy decoding stay compatible; pending external actions must not be replayed on another device solely because they appear in an imported archive.
Watch identity-preserving acknowledged delivery remains a following separate requirement; process-local queue ordering is not its acceptance evidence.
